params.name: fileName
params.description: Full path name of the export file, or "" to display the save-file dialog

params.name: project
params.description: in: contents of the export project (XML text, a reference to a pre-existing DOM element, or a BLOB); out: new contents of the export project, only if '*' was also passed
Forces the export dialog box to be displayed (pre-filled with project) and updates project with the resulting parameters

overloads.semanticRole: Exports the current selection's data to fileName, either silently using a supplied export project or interactively via the export dialog box.

constraints: If fileName is an empty string, the standard save-file dialog is displayed and the Document system variable receives the chosen path; if the user cancels, OK is set to 0.
Passing project performs the export directly without user intervention, unless '*' is also passed.
Since 4D v12, export projects are encoded in XML (Text); the legacy BLOB format from pre-v12 databases can still be read but new projects can no longer be saved back to that format.
Sets the OK system variable to 1 if the export succeeded.
